title: SPORE Galactic Adventures
provenance: Reported by TheLegendGabe (highball-db#600, 2026-10-21), Apple M4, macOS 26.5, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT environment, msync, rated 5 of 5 after 27 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer. The same player's second report (highball-db#637, 2026-10-23), Apple M4, macOS 26.5, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 3 of 5 at the lowest settings in adventures.
notes: Reported perfect on the default engine with DXMT over a 27-minute session, with every graphics setting at its highest: the creature creator and the Sporepedia ran as they do on Windows, by the reporter. Nothing was measured here. In adventures it runs better than on the reporter's Windows PC until about 20 animated props are on screen, then it lags heavily (highball-db#637). A slowdown that grows with animated objects points at the CPU side, likely the old x87 math Rosetta runs slowly, so this game is a candidate for the faster x87 path planned in highball#165. Not measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Heavy lag once more than about 20 animated props are on screen in an adventure, at the lowest settings (reported on an M4, macOS 26.5, DXMT, engine r28)
knownIssues.cause: not measured. It grows with animated objects, so likely CPU-bound under Rosetta
knownIssues.fix: none yet. A candidate for the x87 path in highball#165
